name: Strategy Validation
description: Validate a trading strategy through knowledge rules, backtesting notes, paper-trade evidence, and risk controls.
purpose: Prevent ZAR from treating untested ideas as tradeable systems.

stages.name: Strategy Definition
stages.description: Define the rules before validation starts.

steps.label: Define market, timeframe, setup criteria, entry, exit, stop, target, and invalidation rules.
Define risk limits, max drawdown, max loss, and required sample size.

stages.name: Evidence Review
stages.description: Validate the strategy against simulated results and journal evidence.

steps.label: Review backtesting notes, scanner results, and paper-trading outcomes.
Classify the strategy as reject, revise, observe, or continue paper validation.

userFacingBlurb: Validate a trading strategy before trusting it for future automation.
